notes.frame: Phosphor's music-notes with the bell-slash slash: the lower-left parts run into the slash, the upper-right parts stop 32 units from it.
notes.drawing: The right note head's centre lies 14 units from the slash, so the slash cannot miss it. Its lower-left part would be a sliver against the slash, so only its upper-right arc (more than 32 out) stays, beside the stem.
notes.fill: music-notes-fill, with the right head kept only more than 24 out on the upper-right side, a white band from the slash to 24 out, then the slash (bell-slash-fill).
notes.duotone: The heads are tinted as in music-notes-duotone; the right one only where its arc stays.
